scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the cubic-averaged elastic constants (C̄₁₁, C̄₁₂, C̄₄₄) and the dimensionless Euclidean distance metric from the agent's raw 6×6 stiffness tensor and compares them to the paper's Table VII values with tolerances; it also verifies the monotonic pressure trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for cubic-averaged elastic constants (C̄₁₁, C̄₁₂, C̄₄₄) and dimensionless Euclidean distance metric for three simulation cases.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table VII: Ebrahimi et al., J. Chem. Phys. 140, 154309 (2014).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published Table VII.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: They are the exact paper-reported numbers.

outputs.description: Mean full 6×6 elastic stiffness tensor (Voigt notation) in GPa for each of the three simulation conditions. The checker recomputes cubic-averaged constants and Euclidean distance from the submitted raw matrices and compares them against the paper's reference values.
Log of jammed configurations from NPT runs (sample id, energy, density).

output_contract.notes: The elastic tensors are the core scored artifact. The checker does not rely on any other agent-written file. All derived quantities (C11_avg, C12_avg, C44_avg, Euclidean distance) are recomputed deterministically from the submitted tensors.
